## 6. CURRENT EXACT-ROOT WITNESS STATE

The root shipped with this file is scoped to its own exact bytes and 154 listed leaves:
- root SHA-256: `9b426735bc7c0e94d32ce64ccd87605880c531350ca957ecccde5046bde505cd`
- Merkle root: `2fe2a76f310ea79268c73a94543c91125fa7acc3bbf11ed489afdfeb845ea745`
- Ed25519: VERIFIED under `did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1`
- Rekor: WITNESSED at log index `2714574265`
- OTS proof SHA-256: `91dae23c5e4d8c4914fbfca77e8274e1ddfd71b00baadd8f58e43f3633bdfc99`
- OTS state: `STAMPED_PENDING_BITCOIN` — no Bitcoin block confirmation

This exact-root witness does not bind the separate 335-card index, an entire
measurement history, Hugging Face, or the corrections ledger. The two card corpora
have zero identifier overlap. Machine-readable state: `/interop/root-witness-latest.json`.

## 7. THE MCP DOOR

`POST https://councilof.ai/mcp` with the 4 free tools:
- `board_totals` — the 22 axis summary
- `get_axis` — one axis row
- `verify_card` — verify a supported card and inspect the returned result
- `list_cards` — the signed card index
Additional x402 tool names may be advertised by discovery. Pricing and successful
production settlement are pending verification; a 402 challenge is not a payment receipt.

## 8. THE 5 ACCESS SURFACES

1. MCP — `POST https://councilof.ai/mcp`
2. Chrome MV3 extension source — `https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/council-of-ai/tree/master/extensions/chrome-gspc-verify` (source; no store install claimed)
3. Grok plugin — github.com/CSOAI-ORG/council-of-ai-grok
4. Hermes integration — no public install package is currently advertised
5. REST + curl — `curl https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`
